summary_1line: Rama effortlessly strings Vishnu’s bow, humbles Parasurama, and strips him of his glory, forcing the warrior-sage to acknowledge Rama’s divine supremacy.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama calmly draws Vishnu’s immense bow with a blazing arrow as Parasurama stands stunned and the assembled gods watch from the sky.
The three worlds tremble while Rama holds the fully drawn bow, celestial beings gathering above as Parasurama’s power visibly fades.
Parasurama bows humbly before the lotus‑eyed Rama, admitting his divinity and asking permission to retreat to Mahendra mountain.
